title: Hoist the RegExp allocated on every call inside DomainTermLabels._normaliseEnglishStageName
rule: PF-3 spirit (avoid per-call allocation on a list-render path); Fowler 'extract constant'
why: _normaliseEnglishStageName is invoked from resolveStoredStageName, which (per its own doc comment and the PP-5 regression test) is called once per StageBreakdownEntry.stageName in list rendering — i.e. per row, potentially on every rebuild. Compiling a new RegExp on every call is needless allocation on a path this same file's sibling curriculum_label.dart already knows to avoid: its own Hebrew-detection pattern is hoisted to a static final (curriculum_label.dart:364, `static final RegExp _hebrew = RegExp(...)`).
recommendation: Hoist to a private `static final RegExp _reviewNumbered = RegExp(r'^Review (\d+)$');` at class scope, mirroring curriculum_label.dart's _hebrew pattern.
acceptance_criteria: _normaliseEnglishStageName allocates no new RegExp per call — verified by code review or a grep for `RegExp(` inside method bodies (not field initializers) under lib/core/labels/.
